content: Dorsanne 144,000 Asata
Hessafe guye, Dorsay Xiyoone zuma bolla eqidaysa be7as. Iyara iya sunthaynne iya Aawa sunthay enta som7on xaafetida, 144,000 asay de7ees.
Salope gita haatha guunthunne dada guunthu daaniya wolqaama girsi si7as. Qassi ta si7ida girsay diithi diixishin si7etiya girsaa mela.
144,000 asay araata sinthan, oyddu de7on de7iya medhetethata sinthaninne cimata sinthan eqidi entafe hara oonika tamaaranaw danda7onna ooratha mazmure yexidosona.
Haysati maccasara bantana tunisonna naagida geeshshata. Enti dorsay biya bessi ubbaa kaalloosona. Enti Xoossaasinne Dorsaas bayra gididi, shiiqanaw sa7a asaa giddofe wozetidosona.
Enti wordoynne borey bayna asata.
Heedzu Kiitanchota
Hessafe guye, merinaa Wongela sa7a bolla de7iya kawotethaa ubbaas, koche ubbaas, yara ubbaasinne dumma dumma doona ubbaas markatanaw salora piradhiya hara kiitancho be7as.
He kiitanchoy ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Xoossay alamiya pirdiya saatey gakida gisho Xoossaas yayyite; iya bonchite. Salo, sa7aa, abbanne pulto haatha medhida Xoossaa goyinnite” yaagis.
Koyroysa kaallidi hara nam7antho kiitanchoy, “Dere ubbaa tunanne mathoyiya woyne ushshida, gita Babilooney kundasu! Kundasu!” yaagidi waassis.
Heedzantho kiitanchoy enta kaallidi, ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Do7aanne iya misiliya goyinniya qassi iya malla ba som7on woyko ba kushen wothiya oonika de7iko,
iya hanqo xuu7an kumida Xoossaa hanqo woyniya uyana. Enti geeshsha kiitanchota sinthaninne Dorsa sinthan eexiya diinne taman waayetana.
Enta waayiya cuyay meri merinaw cuyishe daana. Do7aanne iya misiliya goyinney qassi he do7aa suntha mallay de7iya oonika qammanne gallas shempoy bayna kaa7etana” yaagis.
Xoossaa kiitaa naageysatinne Yesuusa ammaneteysati genciya minotethay qonciya wodey hessa.
Hessafe guye, “Hizape Godan hayqeysati anjetidaysata” giya qaala salope si7as. Ayyaanay, “Ee tuma, enta oosoy enta kaalliya gisho, enti banta daaburaape shempana” yaagees.
Kathi Shiisho Wode
Hessafe guye, bootha shaara bolla uttida Asa Na7a daaneysa be7as. I ba huuphen worqa kallacha wothis; qassi ba kushen baaca oykis.
Hara kiitanchoy Xoossa keethafe keyidi, shaara bolla uttidaysako ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, “Kathaa shiisho wodey gakida gisho ne baaca yeddada kathaa caka; sa7an de7iya kathay gakis” yaagis.
Yaatin shaara bolla uttidaysi ba baaca sa7a yeddidi, sa7an de7iya kathaa cakis.
Qassika salon de7iya Xoossa keethafe hara kiitanchoy keyis; iyawuka oco baaci de7ees.

Tama bolla maati de7iya hara kiitanchoy yarsho bessaafe keyis. I ba qaala dhoqu oothidi oco baaca oykida kiitanchuwako, “Woyne ayfey teerida gisho neeni oco baaca yeddada, sa7an de7iya woyniyape qanxa” yaagis.
He kiitanchoy ba baaca yeddidi, sa7an de7iya woyniyape qanxidi, Xoossaa gita hanquwa gum7iya bessan yeggis.
Enti Katamaape gaxan de7iya woyne ayfe gum7iya bessan yedhetidosona. Suuthi woyne gum7iya bessaafe keyidi issi mukulunne usupun xeetu kilo mitire mela haakidi, para puulo gakidi, dhoqu gidi eellis.
